title: Constructing a degree-reducing parity batch from explicit Boolean polynomials
description: Working research manuscript archive containing the PDF, LaTeX source and document checks. An attributed algorithmic corollary of Zhang's generic radical identity and the Moshkovitz-Zhu rank comparison constructs one degree-reducing parity batch from explicit squarefree algebraic normal form. Finite-field specialization and binary intersection give exact all-coset degree reduction on a success event of probability at least 1-delta, with a charged logarithmic codimension loss. Characteristic-two determinant evaluation gives polynomial construction time in the ambient dimension and explicit description length. Full recursive construction and unrestricted XOR log-rank remain unresolved. No established priority, independent peer review, formal certification or implementation is claimed. OpenAI Codex assisted derivation, source comparison, drafting and package preparation.
